body.x: BewellConnect introduced ‘Visio Check’ which is a remote medical platform at ‘CES 2017 Unveiled’ which is held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.

BewellConnect provides health monitoring app which manages several medical deivces in combined way. It also provides a program that connects doctors to users, analyzing the data of injury to take a direct medical care.
VisioCheck is a sort of a remote medical platform, using mobile communication technology and it delivers vital signs to doctors
